observations: 368 aa; calculated molecular weight 39,918 Da and theoretical pI 4.89.

Participates in the aspartate-family amino-acid biosynthetic branch leading to lysine, methionine, homoserine, and threonine.
Functional assignment is homology-supported rather than directly experimentally established for this exact sequence.

observations: L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP(+) = 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H(+), represented in the reverse direction of the biosynthetic reaction.
